display.purpose: Cover headline only (Dela Gothic One); the back cover title runs larger.

headline.purpose: Landing spread titles and the safety page title.

title.purpose: Inspector stage heading, cartridge card names, empty-bench title, legal dialog title, wordmark.

body.purpose: Running copy in Zen Kaku Gothic New 400.

label.purpose: Buttons, field heads, segmented options, tab labels, tags, toasts. Sentence case, 700.

pixel.purpose: DotGothic16 for readouts, number inputs, hex codes, zoom percent, preset counts, callout letters, sprite captions. Never body copy.

numeral.purpose: Thumb-tab numbers, inspector numeral, How to play and safety page numbers.

motion.name: register-art-silk
motion.value: WebGL shader, continuous (requestAnimationFrame), DPR capped at 1.5
motion.purpose: Art register. Slow silk folds on the cover and back cover plates only; pauses off screen and in hidden tabs; one still frame under reduced motion; flat plate without WebGL.

motion.name: silk-ready-fade
motion.purpose: Art register. Silk canvas fades in once its first frame is drawn.

motion.name: step-fast
motion.purpose: UI register. Button, tab, and chip color swaps; toggle thumb jump; toast 8px rise.

motion.name: plate-flood
motion.purpose: UI register. Open tab, inspector numeral, and new stage panel wipe in from the page edge.

motion.name: swatch-cascade
motion.purpose: UI register. Palette swatches flip in one by one on the cover and in the Color stage.

motion.name: step-fill
motion.purpose: UI register. Ghost grid fill: the overlay retracts one row per step (4 to 32 rows).

motion.name: readout-tick
motion.purpose: UI register. Rim and legend numbers roll to new values like a sprite counter.

motion.name: encode-stripe
motion.purpose: UI register. Stepped blue and ink stripe on Download while encoding.

motion.name: saved-stamp
motion.purpose: UI register. Marigold Saved stamp prints over Download, then clears.

motion.name: drop-march
motion.purpose: UI register. Dashed drop-target borders march while a file is dragged over.

motion.name: theme-wipe
motion.purpose: UI register. Theme switch wipes down the page; instant where unsupported.

motion.name: bee-flap
motion.purpose: UI register. Two-frame wing flap on wordmark hover.

motion.name: palette-cycle
motion.purpose: UI register. Cartridge card sprite rotates its palette while hovered.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Every animation and transition collapses to instant; silk holds one frame; ticks and palette cycling skip.

breakpoints.name: cover-standoff
breakpoints.purpose: Cover callouts stand off the sprite in open plate space with leader lines.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Studio stacks (tab strip, fixed-height page, inspector, sticky export bar); How to play goes 2 by 2; cards three across.

breakpoints.name: cover-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Landing cover stacks with the copy first; safety page and Q and A go single column.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Band links hide, panels stack, cards two across; Studio tabs stop sticking and export controls fold behind a disclosure.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Wordmark 16px, extra proof tag hidden, cover button full width.

breakpoints.name: coarse-pointer
breakpoints.purpose: 44px minimum on segmented options, zoom, Download, toast close, and range; palette chips 36px.

narrative.overview:
beexie is the booklet from the game box. The landing is its cover and spreads: a cover plate with a live sprite, numbered "how to play" panels with leader-line callouts on diagrams of real controls, cartridge-label preset cards, a safety page, a Q and A, and a back cover. The Studio is the same booklet opened flat on the desk: the image is the page, the controls are its labeled diagram, and an export bar runs along the bottom edge. Light theme is glossy booklet stock (white paper, black ink); dark theme is the cartridge shell (charcoal plastic) carrying the same plates as label art.

Everything is printed, not lit. Color arrives as flat spot plates (red, marigold, blue, ink) that own whole regions: a tab, a panel head, a card, a page. Edges are square, rules are black, and the sprite is the specimen: rendered by the real pipeline at a true integer scale inside a 3px black key line. Empty space is never blank; it is a ghost cell grid waiting to be filled. Readouts sit in fixed slots in a fixed-width pixel face, so numbers change without anything reflowing.

Motion has two registers and nothing between them. The two large art plates (the maroon cover and the blue back cover) carry a slow WebGL silk that glides continuously. Every UI change snaps in `steps()` like a sprite: tabs flood in, swatches flip, readouts tick, the ghost grid fills row by row. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the silk holds one still frame and every stepped change is instant.
keyCharacteristics: Booklet stock (`#ffffff`) and cartridge shell (`#1d1e22`) themes sharing identical red, blue, and near-identical marigold plates; all 27 contrast pairs in `npm run check:contrast` pass WCAG AA.
Flat spot plates and hard-stop fills only; no blended gradients, no shadows, no blur, no rounded corners.
Heavy Japanese-style gothic display (Dela Gothic One) over a clean gothic UI face (Zen Kaku Gothic New), with DotGothic16 reserved for numerals, readouts, and sprite captions.
Sprites printed by the real pipeline at `floor(available / cells) * cells`, so every art pixel is the same size, always `image-rendering: pixelated`.
Two motion registers: art plates glide, UI steps.

rules.name: The Stage Plate Rule
rules.body: In the Studio, the stage in use owns one plate (Image red, Grid marigold, Color blue, Finish ink) and only the stage furniture takes it: the open thumb tab, the inspector numeral, the active grid preset, and the Pixel proof tag. Every other color on screen is ink, paper, or a fixed-role plate.

rules.name: The Fixed Roles Rule
rules.body: In UI, outside the stage plate, each plate means one thing: blue is the action, red is the compare rule and errors, marigold is attention (on, busy, selected, saved). Only label art may use plates freely: the landing cover, How to play heads, cartridge cards, the safety page, and the back cover.

rules.name: The Text-Grade Rule
rules.body: Plates are fields; text on paper uses the text-grade variant (`red-plate-text`, `red-text-on-shell`, `blue-text-on-shell`). Never set red or blue plate values as small text on the dark shell.

rules.name: The Pixel Face Rule
rules.body: DotGothic16 prints numbers, readouts, codes, lettered callout marks, and short captions, including numeric controls (grid size chips, preset counts, zoom percent). It never sets body copy, headings, or worded labels.

rules.name: The Fixed Slot Rule
rules.body: Every changing number sits in a slot of fixed width (`min-width: 8ch` on rim readouts, `13ch` on the export Output, 64px on zoom percent) in the fixed-width pixel face, so values tick without moving their neighbors.

rules.name: The Plain Weight Rule
rules.body: Display type is used at weight 400 only (Dela Gothic One has one weight); emphasis in UI copy is Zen Kaku Gothic New 700. No uppercase transforms, no wide tracking.

rules.name: The Printed Depth Rule
rules.body: If something needs to read as on top, give it a plate, a heavier rule, or an overlap. Never a shadow.

dos: **Do** give the stage in use its plate (Image red, Grid marigold, Color blue, Finish ink) on its tab, numeral, active preset, and Pixel tag, and keep everything else ink and paper.
**Do** keep blue for actions, red for the compare rule and errors, and marigold for on, busy, selected, and saved states.
**Do** draw with hard-stop fills: ghost grids, the checker, slider fill, and stripes are hard-edged `linear-gradient` stops, never blends.
**Do** separate regions with a 2px ink rule and subdivide with a 1px rule; mark what is in front with a plate or an overlap.
**Do** render every sprite and preview at a true integer scale with `image-rendering: pixelated`, inside a black key line.
**Do** put changing numbers in the pixel face inside fixed-width slots, and roll them in steps.
**Do** animate UI in discrete steps (`steps()` in CSS, fixed-interval frames in script), and route every animation through the reduced-motion reset.
**Do** keep silk on the two landing art plates, with a flat fallback color and white text above 4.5:1 against the brightest sheen; add any new plate pair to `scripts/check-contrast.cjs`.
donts: **Don't** use `box-shadow`, blur, glows, or blended gradients on any UI element.
**Don't** round a corner; the bee mark and line icons are the only curves.
**Don't** flood more than one stage plate at a time in the Studio, or put plate color on a control that is neither active stage furniture nor a fixed-role element.
**Don't** put silk, or any eased glide, on controls, tabs, panels, readouts, or the Studio.
**Don't** set body copy, headings, or worded labels in DotGothic16, and don't uppercase or letter-space labels.
**Don't** fake pixel art with CSS filters or smoothing; every sprite on the page is real pipeline output.
**Don't** print real console names, logos, seals, or trade dress on cards, labels, or copy.
